nodes.description: Owner address set in constructor; gates all onlyOwner administrative functions.
TRUSTED_DEPOSIT_TOKEN_ADDRESS: stake/principal token used for transfers.
TRUSTED_REWARD_TOKEN_ADDRESS: reward token swapped to deposit token on claim.
REWARD_RATE_X_100: reward emission rate used in getPendingDivs math.
REWARD_INTERVAL: reward accrual window, capped at 365 days.
STAKING_FEE_RATE_X_100: fee taken on stake.
UNSTAKING_FEE_RATE_X_100: fee taken on unstake.
REFERRAL_FEE_RATE_X_100: share of pending rewards routed to referrer.
LOCKUP_TIME: minimum time before unstaking is allowed.
EMERGENCY_WAIT_TIME: constant delay before admin can claim during emergency.
adminCanClaimAfter: constant 395 days used to compute adminClaimableTime.
uniswapV2Router: external router used by doSwap for token conversions.
feeRecipientAddress: destination of staking/unstaking fees.
totalClaimedRewards: cumulative rewards credited to users.
totalClaimedReferralFee: cumulative referral payouts.
contractStartTime: immutable deployment timestamp used for reward window.
isEmergency flag disabling stake/claim/reinvest.
holders: EnumerableSet of staker addresses.
depositedTokens mapping: staked principal per account.
stakingTime mapping: last stake timestamp per account.
lastClaimedTime mapping: timestamp of last reward accrual.
totalEarnedTokens mapping: cumulative rewards per account.
rewardsPendingClaim mapping: claimable reward balance per account.
referrals mapping: referrer per staker, immutable after first set.
totalReferralFeeEarned mapping: cumulative referral fees per referrer.
isTrustedDepositContract mapping gating depositByContract.
adminClaimableTime: timestamp after which owner may sweep tokens.
constructor: sets router, fee recipient, fee rates and timestamps using block.timestamp.
setFeeRecipientAddress: onlyOwner setter of feeRecipientAddress.
setStakingFeeRateX100: onlyOwner setter, requires fee < 100e2.
setUnstakingFeeRateX100: onlyOwner setter, requires fee < 100e2.
setReferralFeeRateX100: onlyOwner setter of referral fee rate.
setUniswapV2Router: onlyOwner setter of the external router used for swaps.
setLockupTime: onlyOwner setter, caps lockup at 90 days.
addTrustedDepositContractAddress: onlyOwner whitelist addition.
removeTrustedDepositContractAddress: onlyOwner whitelist removal.
setContractVariables: onlyOwner batch setter delegating to individual setters.
declareEmergency: onlyOwner; sets isEmergency, resets lockup and adminClaimableTime via now.
doSwap: approves and calls uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokens, an external call.
updateAccount: accrues pending rewards, pays referral fee via external swap/transfer before writing state.
transferReferralFeeIfPossible: swaps reward token then transfers to referrer before accounting.
getPendingDivs: view reward calculation using now, rate, interval and stored balances.
depositByContract: onlyTrustedDepositContract deposit that pulls tokens from msg.sender.
stake: deposits tokens, takes fee, registers referrer, blocks contracts via tx.origin check.
unstake: checks lockup with now, accrues rewards, transfers principal minus fee.
claim: zeroes pending rewards then swaps and transfers out via doSwap.
reInvest: converts pending rewards and adds them back to depositedTokens.
claimAnyToken: onlyOwner sweep of tokens/ETH after adminClaimableTime.
transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership transfer from Ownable base contract.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for balances, ownership and whitelist checks.
block.timestamp (now): used for lockup, reward accrual and admin claim timing.
tx.origin: compared to msg.sender in noContractsAllowed, weak anti-contract guard.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokens / WETH() that hands control to an external contract.
recipient.transfer(amount) sending ETH in claimAnyToken.
External ERC20 safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom calls to token contracts and users.
Reward/fee arithmetic (mul/div/sub via SafeMath) that determines payout amounts.
amountToStake parameter of stake().
referrer parameter of stake().
amountToWithdraw parameter of unstake().
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
pendingDivs local in updateAccount()/getPendingDivs().
fee local computed in stake() and unstake().
amountAfterFee local computed in stake() and unstake().
amount local read from rewardsPendingClaim in claim().
platformTokenReceived local returned by doSwap() and used for transfers/reinvest.

edges.reason: stake() uses msg.sender for token pull, balance updates and referral registration.
unstake() reads depositedTokens[msg.sender] and transfers to msg.sender.
claim() reads rewardsPendingClaim[msg.sender] and pays msg.sender.
reInvest() uses msg.sender balances for compounding.
depositByContract trusts msg.sender as a whitelisted deposit contract.
noContractsAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender in stake().
noContractsAllowed tx.origin check applies to unstake().
noContractsAllowed tx.origin check applies to claim().
noContractsAllowed tx.origin check applies to reInvest().
updateAccount() writes lastClaimedTime[account] = now.
getPendingDivs() relies on now for reward accrual and interval cap.
unstake() enforces now.sub(stakingTime) > LOCKUP_TIME.
claimAnyToken() requires now > adminClaimableTime.
declareEmergency() sets adminClaimableTime using now.
constructor sets contractStartTime and adminClaimableTime from now.
doSwap() makes an external call into the uniswap router before balances are re-read.
transferReferralFeeIfPossible() invokes doSwap() (external call) before accounting.
updateAccount() performs the external referral transfer before updating reward state.
referral payout calls external ERC20 transfer to the referrer.
claim() performs external swap then transfers reward to the caller.
claim() transfers deposit tokens to msg.sender after rewardsPendingClaim reset.
reInvest() swaps reward tokens externally before updating depositedTokens.
reInvest() adds platformTokenReceived to depositedTokens using SafeMath.
stake() pulls and transfers ERC20 tokens via external calls.
unstake() transfers principal and fees via external ERC20 calls.
depositByContract() pulls tokens from the calling contract via safeTransferFrom.
claimAnyToken() sends ETH with recipient.transfer(amount).
claimAnyToken() sweeps arbitrary tokens via safeTransfer.
getPendingDivs() computes rewards with mul/div chains over rate, timeDiff and interval.
stake() computes fee and amountAfterFee arithmetically.
unstake() computes fee and amountAfterFee arithmetically.
claim() relies on accrual arithmetic from updateAccount for the payout amount.
rewardsPendingClaim[account] is written after the external referral transfer.
updateAccount() credits totalEarnedTokens[account].
updateAccount() increments totalClaimedRewards.
updateAccount() refreshes lastClaimedTime[account].
depositByContract() increases depositedTokens[account].
depositByContract() sets stakingTime[account] = now.
stake() adds amountAfterFee to depositedTokens[msg.sender].
stake() sets stakingTime[msg.sender] = now.
stake() records referrals[msg.sender] and referrer sets.
stake() forwards the staking fee to feeRecipientAddress.
unstake() subtracts the withdrawn amount from depositedTokens.
unstake() forwards the unstaking fee to feeRecipientAddress.
claim() zeroes rewardsPendingClaim[msg.sender] before payout.
reInvest() zeroes rewardsPendingClaim[msg.sender].
reInvest() increases depositedTokens[msg.sender] by the received amount.
claimAnyToken() compares now against adminClaimableTime.
getPendingDivs() reads depositedTokens[_holder].
getPendingDivs() reads lastClaimedTime[_holder].
getPendingDivs() checks holders.contains(_holder).
getPendingDivs() uses contractStartTime to bound the reward window.
getPendingDivs() multiplies by REWARD_RATE_X_100.
getPendingDivs() divides by REWARD_INTERVAL.
declareEmergency() sets isEmergency = true.
declareEmergency() sets LOCKUP_TIME = 0.
declareEmergency() sets adminClaimableTime to now + EMERGENCY_WAIT_TIME.
constructor sets immutable contractStartTime.
constructor sets adminClaimableTime = now + adminCanClaimAfter.
transferOwnership() rewrites the owner state variable, transferring privileges.
claimAnyToken() is gated by onlyOwner.
declareEmergency() is gated by onlyOwner.
setContractVariables() is gated by onlyOwner and can rewrite all fee/lockup params.
addTrustedDepositContractAddress() is gated by onlyOwner.
setFeeRecipientAddress() is gated by onlyOwner.
depositByContract() is gated by onlyTrustedDepositContract on msg.sender.
setUniswapV2Router() writes the uniswapV2Router state variable used by doSwap.
setFeeRecipientAddress() writes feeRecipientAddress.
setLockupTime() writes LOCKUP_TIME.
setStakingFeeRateX100() writes STAKING_FEE_RATE_X_100.
setUnstakingFeeRateX100() writes UNSTAKING_FEE_RATE_X_100.
setReferralFeeRateX100() writes REFERRAL_FEE_RATE_X_100.
amountToStake drives the token pull and depositedTokens update in stake().
referrer is written into referrals[msg.sender] inside stake().
amountToWithdraw bounds the transfer and balance subtraction in unstake().
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner in transferOwnership().
pendingDivs local carries the accrued reward amount inside updateAccount().
fee local computed from STAKING_FEE_RATE_X_100 in stake().
amountAfterFee local is written into depositedTokens in stake().
claim amount local read from rewardsPendingClaim in claim().
platformTokenReceived is the return value produced by doSwap().

normalization_plan.reason: Stake input length/value is fully consumed by the stake() function logic.
Referrer input is only used inside stake() for referral bookkeeping.
Withdrawal amount input is only meaningful within unstake().
New owner input is only consumed by transferOwnership().
Computed reward local is an internal artifact of updateAccount() accounting.
Fee local is derived from the staking fee rate inside stake().
Post-fee amount local feeds directly into the stake balance update.
Claim amount local is the reward balance read within claim().
Swap output local is produced by doSwap() and immediately consumed by its callers.
